Hi Maya — thanks for the XLS and context. Quick read-through below and proposed next steps.

High-level recommendation (short):
1) Commit-tiering in 3 phases: base committed spend (reserved pool) + seasonal buffer tier + on-demand overage.
2) Escrow staging for the seasonal buffer (monthly draw windows) to reduce invoice friction for Aurora.
3) Co-sell registration submitted once PO is countersigned; Redwood will provide the co-sell materials and primary sales contact.

Things we need from Aurora to finalize the legal / billing flow:
- Monthly forecast granularity (preferred) or quarterly if that’s simpler.
- PO with billing entity and invoice remit address.
- Any reseller/partner carve-outs we should know about.

I've attached a short write-up with the tiering model and an initial example schedule so procurement can see invoice timing: redwood-commit-tiering-v1.pdf. I also created a HubSpot deal and linked your XLS — https://app.hubspot.com/deals/4837.

If this looks good I can spin up a DocuSign envelope for the PO and a follow-up onboarding kickoff (Ops + Marketplace).

Next steps:
- Maya / procurement: confirm forecast cadence and send the PO.
- Marissa / Jonas (cc'd): I'll hand off to Marissa for billing cadence; Jonas to coordinate marketplace provisioning.

Hi Maya — looping in the billing plan and a proposed drawdown cadence.

Summary of proposed cadence (attached CSV shows month-by-month numbers):
- Phase 1 (Month 1–3): Base commit = $120k/month; seasonal buffer = $40k/month (held in escrow, released monthly against consumption).
- Phase 2 (Month 4–6): If consumption > 85% of combined tiers, buffer converts into committed capacity for the remainder of term.
- Phase 3 (Month 7+): Reassessment window; any unused buffer capacity expires and does not auto-add to base unless both parties agree.

Invoice cadence options: monthly invoicing with statement of consumption (preferred by us, aligns with marketplace reporting) or quarterly consolidated invoices if your AP team prefers fewer invoices. Please confirm which you prefer and we’ll build it into the PO and DocuSign.

Next logistical items we will action once we receive the countersigned PO:
- Submit co-sell registration (Redwood sales lead assignment).
- Start marketplace onboarding checklist and reserve a listing slot in GCP staging (Jonas on ops deadline).
- Kickoff technical onboarding (Ben + Redwood solutions engineer).
